risks.risk: Laptop may not be the claimed model (HP Pavilion 15)
risks.proof: Photo of the model name or number on the bottom or lid, or a system info screenshot showing model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic HP laptop, not Pavilion 15, which may be lower value.

risks.risk: Processor may not be 8th Gen Intel Core i5
risks.proof: System information screenshot showing CPU model, or a clear photo of the CPU sticker with generation number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic i5, which may be lower value if older or newer generation.

risks.proof: System information screenshot showing storage type and size, or internal photo of SSD.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown storage, possibly HDD or smaller SSD, reducing value.

risks.proof: System information screenshot showing RAM amount, or internal photo of RAM modules.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown RAM, possibly less than 8GB, reducing value.

risks.risk: Fingerprint reader may not be present
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the touchpad or keyboard area showing fingerprint sensor.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without fingerprint reader, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop may have physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all edges, hinges, screen bezel, and bottom.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minor wear, but could be damaged, reducing value.

proof_requests: System information screenshot showing model, CPU, RAM, and storage.
Close-up photo of the model name on the bottom or lid.
Photo of the fingerprint reader if present.
Full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all edges, hinges, and screen bezel.
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as an HP laptop, but the model, processor generation, storage, RAM, and fingerprint reader cannot be confirmed from the photos. These are critical for pricing. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately and must be asked for further evidence.
